text: In Rawalpindi’s historic Bhabra Bazaar, 72-year-old Ahsan Shakeel restores antique brass and copper utensils, preserving a craft passed down from his father. As traditional metalware gives way to modern kitchenware, he remains among the few keeping this centuries-old trade alive.
